questions.stem: Sarah is a 30-year-old female who presents to her primary care physician with shortness of breath and chest pain on exertion. She reports feeling fatigued lately and has a family history of heart disease. On physical examination, her blood pressure is 120/80 mmHg, and her heart rate is 90 beats per minute. Auscultation of her heart reveals a harsh systolic murmur heard best at the right upper sternal border. An echocardiogram is ordered, which shows moderate aortic stenosis with a bicuspid aortic valve. What could be the most likely cause of Sarah's aortic stenosis?
